purpose: Classify website users by their relationship to the business, goals, permissions, and interactions.
classification_principles: A user group is a hypothesis until supported by project evidence.
One person may belong to multiple user groups.
A job title does not fully describe user goals or behavior.
User groups and system roles are related but not interchangeable.
Do not infer sensitive personal characteristics.
Add industry-specific groups when supported by the project context.

rules: Do not infer digital confidence from age, disability, job title, or appearance.
Use observed support needs only when supported by research or testing.
Do not treat an unassessed user as low-confidence.

validation_rules: Each group must have a unique identifier within the project.
Do not claim that all members of a group behave identically.
Record evidence for material claims about needs or barriers.
Keep unknown access permissions unresolved until verified.
Do not invent user group sizes or percentages.
